description: Fork of exp091 with within-chunk pair restriction for residual_lut. Each layer i's residual_lut is built with partition_sets=[chunk_0, chunk_1, ..., chunk_i] (E-slot chunks of the inverse-concat input) and NO partition_pair_weights — sampling is uniform across the within-chunk pool, so each pair is constrained to lie within a single chunk, but a single table can contain pairs drawn from multiple chunks. Anchor inheritance from layer (i-1) and split LR/WD from exp091 are unchanged.
